description: UninstallView - collect the installed-program entries scattered across the registry into one list and uninstall from it
notes: Runs unelevated by default - Ctrl+F11 (or /RunAsAdmin) restarts it as administrator, which is what the HKLM-wide and shadow-copy views need.
Settings go to UninstallView.cfg next to the exe, written when the window closes - pre-created as an empty file so scoop persists it as a file, not a directory junction.
A translation file (UninstallView.exe /savelangfile writes uninstallview_lng.ini) is deliberately not persisted: an empty placeholder would be loaded as an empty translation and blank out the UI.
The download URLs carry no version, so checkver watches the PAD manifest and every version bump re-hashes the same two zips.
